subject: Last-mile coverage sprint — commit triage & finance sync
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Last-mile coverage sprint — initial gap numbers and asks

Team,

Quick summary from the forecast pass this morning: Q4 target = $6.2M. Current pipe (staged OPs only) sits at $3.9M — coverage gap = $2.3M (coverage ratio ~0.63x). We have a handful of late-stage opportunities that are high-prob but under-documented in HubSpot which is depressing our committed run-rate.

A few tactical asks so we can close the books for the finance forecast lock on 10/20:
- By EOD 10/16, update Stage/Close Probability for all opportunities with >$50k ACV. Use the stage mapping in the snapshot.
- Mark any accounts with procurement paperwork in flight — attach the PoC/PO/Docusign link.
- If you have a true verbal commit, move to Commit and reply in-thread with the expected close date and any conditions.

I attached a filtered pipeline snapshot (pipeline_snapshot_Q4.xlsx). Please pull the report, update hubspot, and flag anything you want Marcus/Finance to consider for a one-off credit or timing adjustment.

If we can't bridge >$1.5M via committed updates, we'll need to propose a shortfall contingency to Finance. I'm asking Laura to highlight any runway levers we can use (credits, stretch billing) and Aditya to coordinate any legal/terms exceptions we may need.

Thanks,
Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
VP, Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Oct 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Last-mile coverage sprint — initial gap numbers and asks

Thanks Marcus — I'm on it. Quick visibility into my book: I've updated the sheet with four accounts I own that can move this week. Highlights below (I've also attached the MAP with specific asks):

- Velocity Systems (>$600k ARR) — Sales exec: Neha. Current stage: Legal Review (Sales Ops shows 60%); verbal commit on 10/14. Procurement requested a standard SOW + security checklist. Expected close: 10/19.
- Blue Harbor (>$180k) — stage: Exec Buy-in; need EMEA pricing approval; confident 50% close by 10/25.
- Meridian Analytics (>$120k) — stage: Commit; PO inbound pending final signature (procurement loop). Expected close: 10/18.
- TrueNorth Labs (>$80k) — stage: Negotiation; pricing ask to finance for a one-time onboarding credit.

Actions I'm taking:
- Pushing Velocity procurement this morning (email thread below); attaching the MAP (mutual_action_plan_v3.pdf) to the Velocity contact.
- Updating HubSpot deal fields for Meridian and TrueNorth now — will add PO/Docusign links as they come in.
- If Finance is open to a small onboarding credit for TrueNorth to accelerate commit, flag to Laura.

I'll reply here the moment I get procurement confirmation from Velocity.

Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0189

Neha / Marcus,

Thanks for the update and the MAP. Confirming we have budget approved — procurement is just validating the SOW and security checklist. Two requests on our side:

1) Can Redwood provide the SOC2 evidence and the solution architecture diagram for our security team?
2) We prefer a single annual invoice and need standard termination language clarified in Clause 9.

We can sign once procurement gets the SOW + security pack. We are aiming for 10/19 close. Will loop procurement (procure@acme-inc.com) on any legal redlines.

-Taylor

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Oct 2028 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Last-mile coverage sprint — initial gap numbers and asks

Appreciate the updates. Quick finance view after running the revised commit roll: if the four deals Neha listed convert as expected, we pick up ~$880k in committed ARR which reduces the shortfall to ~1.42M. That's still above the acceptable variance threshold, so two recommendations:

1) Approve up to $40k in onboarding credits (one-off) for strategic closers where credit materially increases conversion probability (Neha — TrueNorth seems a fit). I can approve centrally for deals <= $40k.
2) We should mark a subset of ‘likely’ opportunities (>$100k, >=50% confidence) as Assisted Commit so Finance can include them in the plan with conditional recognition; requires Sales Leader sign-off.

If Marcus signs off on Assisted Commit classification for the three accounts he flagged last week and Neha’s Velocity + Meridian, Finance will include $1.1M of conditional ARR to present at lock with clear callouts in the forecast deck.

Please confirm approvals by COB Monday 10/22 so we can finalize numbers for the board pack.

Laura Bennett
Director, FP&A | Redwood Inference
